rationale: The description explicitly characterizes the data-management suite as offering AI-empowered capabilities.
ai_type_rationale: The text identifies hybrid data management as the product family and describes capabilities to manage structured and unstructured data, suggesting AI enhances data management; it does not establish that this conventional management core remains without AI, so the subtype stays weak/forced.
evidence_spans: a complete suite of AI-empowered capabilities designed to help you manage both structured and unstructured data
ai_type_evidence_spans: a family of hybrid data management products offering a complete suite of AI-empowered capabilities designed to help you manage both structured and unstructured data
conflict_response: The binary AI label is supported by the explicit phrase “AI-empowered capabilities.” For subtype, the description does call these data-management products and describes data management, but it frames the suite's capabilities as AI-empowered and does not say whether meaningful data-management functionality remains without AI. Thus enabled is the best-supported subtype, but the description alone does not resolve the concern enough for supported subtype evidence; I retain weak/forced rather than treating the labeler's supported subtype or agreement as evidence.
